title: A novel multifunctional fluorescent probe with ESIPT and AIE effects for the detection of Co2+ and HClO
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4000-4013
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07451C, Paper

Chenxiang Lu, Jiawei Xu, Zhe Song, Guoqin Zhu, Zhenya Dai
We developed a novel fluorescent probe featuring excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) and aggregation-induced emission (AIE) effects, which displayed dual-channel fluorescence emission.
